title: Asian Games: Carlo Paalam advances to boxing quarterfinals

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Carlo Paalam advanced to the quarterfinals Asian Games 2026 men’s boxing 55kg division after beating India’s Jadumani Singh Mandengbam, 3-2, on Friday at Nishio Gymnasium. Paalam, who got a first round bye, was tested in his round of 16 match, with the Indian boxer using his aggression to push the Filipino to his limits. But Paalam secured the win, getting 29-27 scores from two judges and a 30-26 edge from another, while two other judges scored the bout 28-28. The Olympic silver medalist will fight for […]...
